digest.component_or_area: plan-review: AC-satisfiability criterion and container child-coverage audit
propositions: Plan review certifies tickets with mutually unsatisfiable acceptance criteria across parent and children, causing late-stage contradictions and forcing full LLM re-reviews when descriptions are amended.

No existing plan-review criterion owns the concern of whether a ticket's own AC and its Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations are jointly satisfiable; a new 1-TURN advisory criterion ac-satisfiability on coherence facet must be added to catch set-quantification contradictions.

G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire because it receives only child ids and titles, not their acceptance criteria; the sibling roster must be enriched with each child's AC items extracted via evaluate_plan_clarity.

The sibling-roster-building expression is duplicated in three independent places (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py), causing divergence between production and eval harnesses; a single shared build_sibling_roster helper must consolidate the expression.

The sibling roster must be sent once in the stable system-prompt prefix rather than repeated in per-pairing instructions, and its token cost must be included in the parent_tokens estimate for bin-packing and caching decisions.
G3's rubric must discharge the no-sibling-covers-it test against the roster's enriched acceptance criteria rather than only against ids and titles.
